optimizedContext.value:
# CLI Entrypoint

## Rules
### Configuration discovery
- No `--config`: walk CWD→git root for first `specd.yaml`; none → exit 1 + stderr error
- Halts at git root (or FS root if no git); does not cross repository boundaries

### Config flag override
- Global `--config <path>` on root; before or after subcommand. Subcommands MAY declare own `--config`
- Root `preAction` propagates root `--config` to subcommand lacking own `--config`
- Commander lifts any `--config` to root; `preAction` sets action command via `setOptionValue` from `program.opts().config`
- Explicit path skips discovery; missing/unparseable → exit 1
- Duplicate `--config` → Commander last-value-wins

### Output conventions
- Normal → stdout; errors/warnings/diagnostics → stderr; never mix

### Exit codes
- 0 success; 1 user/domain; 2 hook failure (`run:` non-zero, forward hook streams); 3 system
- No other codes. Hook domain error that exits 1 still yields CLI exit 2

### Error message format
- Exit 1: stderr `error:` line
- Exit 3: stderr `fatal:`; stack only if `Logger.isLevelEnabled('debug')`

### Output format flag
- `--format text|json|toon` default `text`; json/toon → stdout same data model
- Errors always plain `error:`/`fatal:` on stderr

### Structured error output
- Typed errors per Specd Error Contract (`default:_global/error-handling-conventions`)
- `SpecdCliError` extends `SpecdError`; no bare `Error` in formatters/helpers/validation
- `handleError` emits structured JSON/TOON without stack on stdout when format json/toon

### JSON/TOON output schema in help
- Commands w/ `--format json|toon`: `addHelpText('after', ...)` block starting `\nJSON/TOON output schema:`
- TS-style shape; `//` only if needed; `?` optional; inline array element types

### Host package SDK dependency boundary
- `@specd/cli` + `@specd/mcp`: only `@specd/sdk` among platform pkgs (`core`/`code-graph`/`sdk`). Plugin, schema, third-party deps unaffected
- `@specd/mcp` declares `@specd/sdk` even with no MCP tools yet

### Banner version labels
- Root help: versions for `@specd/cli`, `@specd/sdk`, `CORE_VERSION`, `codeGraphVersion` via SDK re-exports

### Excess arguments rejected
- Leaf cmds reject unexpected positionals → exit 1 + usage stderr
- `.allowExcessArguments(false)` required

### Banner in help
- `specd --help`: ASCII banner via `addHelpText('before', ...)`; NOT on subcommand help

### Auto-show dashboard
- Bare `specd` or `specd --config <path>`: if config found → `project dashboard`; else help

### Top-level init alias
- `specd init` ≡ `specd project init` (flags/wizard/exits/formats); listed in root help

### Terminal-aware table rendering
- `renderTable` and `fitColumnsToTerminal` adapt to `process.stdout.columns` or explicit `terminalWidth`
- Width + spacing over terminal → shrink columns right-to-left to min width default 10. Column already under threshold MUST NOT expand
- Narrowed content: wrap when `overflow: 'wrap'`; truncate with `…` when `overflow: 'truncate'`
- Non-TTY (pipes, tests without columns): natural unconstrained widths

### Decoupled program instantiation
- `createProgram(): Command` holds program config and command registrations, separate from process execution
- Enables inspection, command-tree traversal, docs coverage checks without argument parsing

## Constraints
- Stdout/stderr independent
- Exit 2 exclusive to hooks
- `--format` never changes stderr text; json/toon also write structured error to stdout
- Banner root-help only
